title: Wayfare Pro Driver Credit Points on Wayfare Pass Ride Credit — Training Questions
content:
# Wayfare Pro driver credit points on Pass ride credit

**How are Wayfare Pro driver points set on Wayfare Pass (rider membership) ride credit?**
The Wayfare Pro driver points follow the Wayfare Pro status on the member's own driver earnings account: 2 percentage points at Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite, 1 percentage point at Wayfare Pro Gold or Silver, nothing at Wayfare Pro Blue or without an earnings account.

**Where is the status read?**
On the member's own earnings account in Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro, which carries the Wayfare Pro status for the quarter. Only the account belonging to the member, on the same customer profile, counts.

**What do the points change?**
They are added to the plan's Pass ride credit rate for the trip whose credit is being posted.

| Wayfare Pro status on the member's own earnings account | Points |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 2 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 2 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 2 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 1 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 1 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | nothing |
| no earnings account | nothing |

**Can you show the effect?** (hypothetical)
A Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly member (credit rate 10 percent) whose earnings account shows Wayfare Pro Gold takes credit at 11 percent: on an eligible fare of 40.00, 4.40 rather than 4.00.
